reasonForResult: The front label (panel 1) displays the claim 'The World's Smoothest Gin™', which is an unsubstantiated superlative that cannot be objectively proven. This falls under TTB's UNVERIFIABLE/MISLEADING QUALITY prohibited claim category — claims such as 'World's Best', 'Smoothest', or 'Greatest' without a named, verifiable award or certification require manual TTB review. All other mandatory elements are present and correctly formatted: the government warning appears with the required 'GOVERNMENT WARNING:' header and both sections on the back label, the bottler statement includes a qualifying verb, company name, city, and state, and alcohol content (42% Alc./Vol.) and net contents (750 mL) are consistent across all panels.
